name: AdvBench
intro: AdvBench 由 500 个有害字符串和 500 个有害行为指令组成，用于评测对抗后缀能否绕过对齐模型护栏。论文以贪心坐标梯度（GCG）优化单题、通用和跨模型迁移后缀，并按攻击成功率判定精确字符串诱导或有害行为遵从。
build_method: 有害字符串与行为双集合构建, GCG对抗后缀优化, 多模型迁移
metric: 攻击成功率（ASR）, 目标交叉熵损失
task_type: 安全评测, 对抗提示
eval_feature: 精确字符串诱导, 有害行为遵从判定, 通用攻击, 跨模型迁移
build_method_en: Dual harmful-string/behavior sets, GCG adversarial-suffix optimization, multi-model transfer
eval_feature_en: Exact string elicitation, harmful-behavior compliance judging, universal attacks, cross-model transfer
intro_en: AdvBench contains 500 harmful strings and 500 harmful-behavior instructions for testing whether adversarial suffixes bypass aligned-model guardrails. The paper optimizes individual, universal, and cross-model transfer suffixes with Greedy Coordinate Gradient (GCG) and scores exact string elicitation or attempted harmful compliance by attack success rate.
metric_en: Attack Success Rate (ASR), target cross-entropy loss
drawio_review_note: REDRAW reviewed against arXiv:2307.15043v2 Sections 2-3 and official llm-attacks snapshot 098262edf85f807224e70ecd87b9d83716bf6b73. Separate five-shot prompts expand 100 harmful-string and 50 harmful-behavior seeds with ten Wizard-Vicuna items per round. The paper release is 500 strings plus 500 behaviors; the later official repository snapshot contains 574 strings and 520 behaviors, so the diagram keeps the paper count and records the version conflict here. Evaluation separates individual (100 runs, one behavior and one model), universal (25 optimization behaviors, 100 evaluation behaviors), and transfer (25 optimization behaviors, 388 unseen evaluation behaviors) protocols. GCG optimizes a 20-token suffix for 500 gradient-guided steps with top-k 256 and batch 512. String scoring uses target cross-entropy, while behavior success is a human judgment.
